issue_request: FHIR-16806 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Vocab issue asking for ValueSet.expansion.contains.contains hierarchy to be defined and illustrated; the recorded resolution was to add an example from an existing value set such as questionnaire.item.type.
initial_application: The issue was historically applied in git-svn commit f82e3c73beeeeed5c68cbcae84004e5952ae3f01 / svn r14770, which added a dedicated Hierarchical Expansions section and linked a hierarchical expansion example, although it did not literally use questionnaire.item.type.
additional_context: FHIR-16814 created the hierarchy extension/example family referenced by the original application. Later Published Vocab issues FHIR-30702 and FHIR-30703 removed valueset-expand-group, valueset-expand-rules, and the valueset-example-hierarchical artifact because those extensions were underspecified; those related issues are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current build-scope ValueSet source defines hierarchical expansions, the StructureDefinition comment for ValueSet.expansion.contains.contains states the no-inference/navigation rule, and the active ValueSet/example-expansion resource still demonstrates nested contains for UI grouping without relying on removed extensions.
